name: harvest-pack
title: Harvest declaration preparation pack
for_each: select id,code from harvests order by code

sections.title: Source records
sections.note: Preparation only. Complete and sign the current MPI form for each delivery. This is not a harvest declaration, food safety clearance or export certificate.

sections.title: Treatment history to review
sections.sql: select product,applied_on,instructions,removal_due,removed_on,harvest_clear_on from treatments where site_id=(select site_id from harvests where id=$1) order by applied_on
sections.note: Includes all recorded treatment history, including entries after harvest. Review the dates and original instructions.

name: batch-trace
title: Extraction batch record
for_each: select id,code from batches order by code

sections.title: Harvest inputs
sections.sql: select h.code,s.name as site,s.registration,h.harvested_on,i.kg,h.declaration_ref,h.evidence_ref from batch_inputs i join harvests h on h.id=i.harvest_id join sites s on s.id=h.site_id where i.batch_id=$1
sections.note: Input weights, not final drum weight. Reconcile extraction losses and processor records separately.

name: site-record
title: Apiary site record
for_each: select id,code from sites order by code

sections.title: Inspection history
sections.sql: select inspected_on,inspector,hives_checked,afb,notified_on,notification_ref,action_notes from inspections where site_id=$1 order by inspected_on

sections.title: Access agreements
sections.sql: select name,starts_on,ends_on,terms from agreements where site_id=$1

name: filing-checklist
title: Official filing preparation checklist
for_each: select id,code from filings order by code

sections.title: Filing evidence
sections.note: Local dates and receipts are operator records. Submit through HiveHub or the Management Agency. No filing is sent from here.
